name: ship-game
description: Immersive browser-based sailing game — Angular client + secure Bedrock/Polly API

scripts.start: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:client" "npm run start:server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
